[SWS_DM_00952] Configuration of DTC "max.
FDC
since clear" as extended data
record
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04068, RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referred by
Di-
agnosticEdrDataProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticEdrDataProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_MAX_FDC_SINCE_LAST_CLEAR
, the DM shall report the internal value of the cur-
rent maximum
Fault Detection Counter
since last clear of the contextual DTC
in the respective
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecord
’s
DiagnosticDataElement
.
The length of this
internal data element
is one byte.
⌋
